query:
SELECT 
  famille_chimique,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules), 2) as percentage
FROM molecules
WHERE famille_chimique IS NOT NULL AND famille_chimique != ''
GROUP BY famille_chimique
ORDER BY count DESC
